Appearance:
 Shri Mahesh Prasad Shukla - Advocate for the petitioner.
 Shri Mohan Sausarkar - Government Advocate for the respo
 Order

This petition under Article 226 of Constitution of India has been filed against order dated 14/19/07/2024 by which the representation filed by petitioner for enhancement of compensation has been rejected.

2. It is submitted by counsel for petitioner that earlier the petitioner had approached this Court by filing W.P. No.9881/2024, which was disposed of by Coordinate Bench of this Court by order dated 28th May 2024 and the respondents were directed to consider the prayer of petitioner for conferment of benefits of employment in lieu of acquisition.

It is submitted that by the impugned order only the adequacy or inadequacy of compensation has been decided but the question of employment in lieu of acquisition has not been taken note of.
3.
Considered the submissions made by counsel for petitioner.
4. The representation, which was directed to be decided by a Coordinate Bench of this Court, has been filed as Annexure P/4.
The entire NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:54118 2 WP-30890-2024 representation speaks about inadequacy of compensation.
However, in the prayer clause, it was also mentioned that proper compensation be paid and question of employment be also decided.

Nothing has been mentioned in the representation as to whether any Rehabilitation Policy Rakesh Kumar Mishra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52433243/
1 was in existence or not and whether any other family member of owner of land was given employment in lieu of acquisition or not?

entities.text: Rehabilitation Policy Rakesh Kumar Mishra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Similarly, there is no such averment in the present petition.

5. It is submitted by Shri Mohan Sausarkar that "Part Time Tribunal at Bilaspur and Chhattisgarh"
has been constituted for the Command area of SECL in the States of Chhattisgarh and Madhya Pradesh.

entities.text: Part Time Tribunal at Bilaspur and Chhattisgarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 6. Under these circumstances, this petition is disposed of with following observation:
( i) So far as the question of adequacy/inadequacy of compensation is concerned, this Court is of considered opinion that the Writ Petition in that regard is not maintainable.
An appeal would lie before Tribunal constituted under the Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act, 1957.

entities.text: Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act, 1957
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
(ii) Accordingly, this petition with regard to adequacy/inadequacy of compensation is hereby rejected with liberty to petitioner that if so advised, then he can prefer an appeal as per Section 20 of Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act,
1957.

sentences.text:
(iii) So far as the question of extension of benefit of Rehabilitation Policy is concerned, since petitioner had not made a specific and detailed representation in that regard, therefore, liberty is granted to petitioner that if so advised, then he may file an application for extension of benefit of NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-JBP:54118 3 WP-30890-2024 Rehabilitation Policy (if applicable) and in such a situation the said representation shall be decided strictly in accordance with law without getting influenced of prejudiced by this order.
(G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE SR*
